name: Threat of the Winterfall

aliases: who asks for threat of the winterfall
faq.answer: Donova Snowden is an investigator camped in the snowy wilds of Winterspring. She seeks to curb the furbolg presence across the valley.
The Winterfall are a tribe of furbolgs dwelling in the cold reaches of Winterspring. Donova Snowden considers their pathfinders, den watchers, and totemics an active danger.
The Winterfall furbolgs inhabit the frozen valleys and camps across Winterspring. Donova Snowden monitors them from her post in the region.
faq.q: Where can the Winterfall be found?

sections.body: In the frozen reaches of Winterspring, Donova Snowden watches the local furbolg packs closely. She sees the Winterfall tribe as an encroaching peril across the snows. To keep their numbers in check, she asks you to cull their pathfinders, den watchers, and totemics.
sections.title: Peril in the Snow

summary: Donova Snowden in Winterspring sees the local Winterfall furbolg tribe as a rising menace. She calls upon you to thin their ranks by hunting down their pathfinders, den watchers, and totemics.
